Container.Name: photomigrator
Container.Overview: PhotoMigrator lets you interact with and migrate between photo services such as Google Photos, Synology Photos, Immich Photos, NextCloud Photos, and Google Takeout. Features include automatic migration between services/accounts, Google Takeout analysis with EXIF metadata embedding, album/asset management (upload, download, delete, rename), library organization (duplicates, folder structures), and multi-account support. Includes a web interface (FastAPI) and CLI. For setup instructions and documentation, see: https://github.com/jaimetur/PhotoMigrator
Container.Requires: Create volume paths before first start. On first run the container will generate default Config.ini and docker.conf in the config directory.

Config.Name: Port: Web UI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the PhotoMigrator web interface.

Config.Name: Path: Data
Config.Description: Input/output data directory for migrations and processing.

Config.Name: Path: Volumes
Config.Description: Source directory for photo import. For Google Takeout migration, point this to your extracted Takeout folder (e.g. /mnt/user/immich/Takeout).

Config.Name: Variable: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the container. Important for correct timestamps in logs and file suffixes. See: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones#List

Config.Name: --- User & Permissions ---
Config.Description: Set PUID/PGID to match your Unraid user. Find yours with: id $user

Config.Name: Variable: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as (default: 99 for nobody).

Config.Name: Variable: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as (default: 100 for users).

Config.Name: --- Web Interface (Advanced) ---
Config.Description: Advanced settings for the PhotoMigrator web interface.

Config.Name: Variable: PHOTOMIGRATOR_WEB_DELETE_ROOTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed base folders for the 'Remove Selected' feature in the web UI. Leave empty to disable deletion.

Config.Name: Variable: PHOTOMIGRATOR_WEB_MAX_JOB_OUTPUT_LINES
Config.Description: Maximum number of log output lines to buffer per job in the web UI.
